Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.
What amount in euro is paid to the verifier for the periodic verification of the 35,000 kg gantry crane at position 23?

response.text: How many euros does the verifier receive for carrying out the periodic verification of the 35,000 kg gantry crane listed at position 23?
